sources.quote: 8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
Finish: anodise type II, thickness 10 to 15 micrometres, black, per specification SPEC-FIN-12.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is listed in Annex A of the Stellantis requirements. The effective drawing Rev C specifies anodise type II as the finish. Changing it to a chromate conversion coat changes a requirement on the customer drawing. Clause 8.3.6.1 therefore requires written Stellantis approval before the change is implemented. No document in force contains such an approval.
